senses.definition: n.pr.loc. a royal city of the Canaanites Jos 11:1; 12:19; 𝔊 Μαρρν, Μαδων, Λαμορων;= Madîn. close to Hattîn, Surveyi. 365, dub.; a village Maron lies 2 hours WSW. from Kedesh, van deVeldeMem 146, cf. Di.
